{{Quote|The Grand Master of the Jedi cannot possibly be simply wandering off alone. He must be on a mission of great importance, and it is logical to believe that he has many vessels under his command. A single strike force would do nothing against that.|Yuvar Xal, addressing the Circle of Lords|<ref name="Omen" />}}
'''Yuvar Xal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. By [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], he had taken on the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Ahri Raas]] as his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Xal was one of the many [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who felt [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] presence in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] after the Jedi touched an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], the [[Codex]]. Xal later argued against sending a single strike team after Skywalker, believing the Sith would need a stronger force to bring him down. Nevertheless, Xal and Raas were chosen for the [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike force]] sent to track the [[Sith Meditation Sphere|Meditation Sphere]] [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] and kill Skywalker. Xal served as [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea]]'s [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] for the mission.

Xal grew dissatisfied with Rhea's leadership, however, and began to plot a coup against her. Meanwhile, the team tracked Ship to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] where they met [[Abeloth]], a powerful woman who decided to assist the Sith in their survival. Xal ordered Raas to use Rhea's apprentice, [[Vestara Khai]], to gather information that may assist his coup, and was preparing to initiate it when Ship suddenly returned to the Sith. The team was then transported to [[Sinkhole Station]], where they were to ambush Luke Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]]. During [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|the battle]], Xal gave Raas orders to betray and kill Khai, but the apprentice failed to do so. Khai then threw her [[shikkar]] at Xal, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Yuvar Xal was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] from the remote<ref name="Omen" /> [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He was a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], descendants of a group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had been stranded on the planet in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] when their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Omen]]'', was knocked off-course during a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump while attempting to deliver a shipment of [[Lignan crystal]]s to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. Yuvar Xal [[Sith training|trained]] with the Tribe in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and learned the ways of the Sith. He completed his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprenticeship]] and eventually rose to the rank of [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]]. In [[41 ABY]], [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]], a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]], arrived on the planet to contact the Tribe and assist in the training of their apprentices. Ship informed the Tribe of the near-extinction of the Sith and urged them to conquer the weakened [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. With the help of the Meditation Sphere, the Tribe began to form a [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|new armada]]. Sometime after Ship's arrival on Kesh, Yuvar Xal took on the [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Ahri Raas]] as his apprentice.<ref name="Omen" />

[[File:Luke-Allies.jpg|thumb|left|150px|Luke Skywalker]]
The Tribe's armada numbered over two dozen ships strong by [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], when [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] touched an [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] [[Relics|relic]], the [[Codex]], which magnified his presence and called his name out through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to members of the Tribe. In response to this occurrence, a meeting was called by the [[Circle of Lords]], the Tribe's ruling council, in the [[Circle Chambers]] in [[Tahv]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of Kesh. [[Grand Lord]] [[Darish Vol]] and Lady [[Olaris Rhea]] revealed that they had handpicked a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike team]] to hunt down Skywalker. Xal spoke out against this action, believing that one small team would not be enough to defeat the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], whom he believed would have a large force of ships with him. Rhea, however, held that one or two vessels would better be able to gather information unnoticed than a full [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], and Xal grudgingly accepted her reasoning. Shortly after, Ship abruptly left Kesh,<ref name="Omen" /> and it was decided that the strike team would follow Ship and return it to Kesh before hunting down Skywalker.<ref name="Abyss" />

===Strike team===
{{Quote|Who am I to question the word of ''your'' apprentice, Lady Rhea? If the girl thinks she has a special link to Ship, and if ''you're'' willing to believe her, who am I to question your orders?|Xal, to Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Xal and was assigned to the strike force on the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Eternal Crusader]]'' as Rhea's [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]]. When the Sith landed on [[Abeloth's planet|the planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] to which Ship had led them, Xal was taken along with Rhea as part of the searh party, while a [[Sith Saber]], [[Baad Walusari]], was left in command of the ''Eternal Crusader''. On the planet, the Sith met a powerful being named [[Abeloth]], who was in control of the whole world. Abeloth agreed to help the Sith and keep them safe from the planet's deadly [[Plant/Legends|plants]] and animals, however, at the same time she secretly was preventing Ship from returning to them. While the Sith remained on the planet, tensions began running high, and Xal began to plan for a coup to take over leadership of the team from Rhea. Xal ordered Raas to become closer to Rhea's apprentice, [[Vestara Khai]], in hopes of gleaning something valuable to assist in the coup.<ref name="Abyss" />

[[File:VestaraKhai-FOTJPoster.jpg|thumb|right|175px|Vestara Khai, Xal's killer]]
Before their plans could be carried out, however, Abeloth discovered the presence of Skywalker and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], at [[Sinkhole Station]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the Maw, and allowed Ship to return to the Tribe. The Sith then left the planet to [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|ambush]] the Skywalkers. When they arrived at the station, Xal was set up with Raas, Khai, and Walusari to ambush the Skywalkers with [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], but Xal had given Raas orders to betray his friend and [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] her explosives back at her. When the Jedi arrived on the scene after escaping from the first ambush set up by the Sith, Khai launched her grenades at them, and Raas quickly threw her grenades back at her while Xal turned Walusari's grenades back on him. Rhea, however, had foreseen the betrayal, and had provided Walusari and Khai with a pair of fake grenades to throw first. Meanwhile, Raas' [[Stun grenade/Legends|stun grenades]] appeared to incapacitate one of the Skywalkers, and while Xal moved toward the Jedi, Khai threw her [[shikkar]] at him. The [[Glass/Legends|glass]] blade drove ten centimeters into Xal's body and the Sith Master cried out in surprise and pain as he [[Death/Legends|died]]. Raas, distracted by his master's yell, was quickly killed by the supposedly stunned Skywalker.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Ahri and I have been best friends since we were Tyros."''<br />''"I thought as much. That's why Xal picked him.|Vestara Khai and Olaris Rhea|<ref name="Abyss" />}}
Yuvar Xal was rather outspoken and openly expressed his views on a subject matter, even when they differed from that of the Circle of Lords. After his observation was dismissed by Rhea, Xal was upset, but he accepted her decision.<ref name="Omen" /> Later, however, as part of the strike team, Xal became dissatisfied with Rhea's leadership, and prepared to betray her. He included his apprentice in his plans, using him to get close to Khai, Raas' best friend and Rhea's apprentice, in hopes of finding out information that could prove useful to his rebellion. He finally initiated the coup during the battle with the Skywalkers, but it had been foreseen by Rhea and was unsuccessful, resulting in Xal's death at Khai's hands.<ref name="Abyss" />

==Powers and abilities==
Xal was trained in the dark side of the Force and the ways of the Sith. He completed his apprenticeship and eventually rose to the prestigious rank of Sith Master, taking on the [[Sith Tyro|Tyro]] Ahri Raas as his apprentice. He was an influential member of the Tribe, and felt free to speak out during the meeting in Tahv after Skywalker's presence was revealed to the Sith&mdash;an act which someone of lesser power would not have been allowed to do.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yuvar Xal was created by author [[Christie Golden]] for her debut ''[[Star Wars]]'' novel, ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', released [[June 23]], [[2009]] as the second installment in the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series.
